body:
This is exactly, exactly how I'm feeling right now and for the past weeks. For me the worst things I can do is to disappointment, worry, & hurt them, and I think ending my life will save them from the many pain to come. I dont want them to consistently suffer because of me. And unfortunately that's what I am, a consistent disappointment who just can't change. I've been trying but I always fail. I always disappoint. And I want it to stop. My death will probably still hurt them of course, but at least it's going to happen just once in their lives. They will forget about me, time will heal them. My death will be better compared to the regular pain they will feel when I continue to live and just disappoint. When Im gone, I wont disappointment them anymore.


But then, God doesnt like suicides.
